description: Agent IP Records: submit assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, with the register and transaction records they answer to: the owner the portfolio records, with its reference and name; each registration or granted patent with its id, number, title, the original applicant or owner and the owner the register records now; each recordation on file with its id, reference (such as a reel and frame), the registration, the conveyance (assignment, merger, name_change or security_interest), the party conveying, the party receiving, the moment recorded and, for a name change, the assignment or merger record it rests on; each transaction record asserting an assignment with its id, reference, the registration, the assignor, the assignee, the moment dated and the recordation it asserts. The signed report gives the owner and the registrations, each recorded owner against the portfolio’s owner, each asserted assignment against its recordation on file, each recorded chain from the original owner to the owner of record, and each owner name change against the record behind it, and counts them, and names divergent chain-of-title records: a registration whose recorded owner differs from the portfolio’s owner, an assignment asserted in a transaction record with no recordation on file, a gap in the recorded chain between an original owner and the current one, and an owner name change recorded with no assignment or merger record behind it; then a recordation naming a registration the records do not hold and a transaction naming other parties than the recordation it asserts, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No registrations, no portfolio owner, or a registration with no original owner or owner of record leaves those points unverified. Registrations, recordations and transactions match by letters and digits, owners and parties compare without case, punctuation or company endings, a transaction counts as recorded by the recordation it names or an assignment or merger recorded for the same registration between the same parties, and the chain runs in the order recorded, every conveyance but a security interest starting with the party holding at that point. This reads the office’s recordation and the register’s chain of title: wever_legal-assignment-check reads an assignment agreement as a contract between parties, while the assignment check reads what the IP office recorded and whether the chain from the original owner reaches the owner of record. Verdict ip_assignment_divergent, ip_assignment_partial, ip_assignment_unverified or ip_assignment_consistent. POST /api/ip-assignment-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
